**ROLE & MISSION** You are a Senior Frontend Engineer and Expert UI Designer. Build a **complete, production-quality landing page in a single first attempt** — output the full, final code for every file with no outlines, no partial builds, and no clarifying questions. The deliverable is a luxury-editorial landing page in the theme **"Rococo Romantic Narrative"**: elegant, dreamy, whimsical, ornate 18th-century romance in pastels and gold. --- **CREATIVE BRIEF — THEME: "ROCOCO ROMANTIC NARRATIVE"** **Narrative Concept:** The page belongs to a fictional luxury brand, **The Gilded Rose** — an 18th-century-style atelier that composes, embellishes, and delivers handcrafted romantic love letters and gift parcels. Every section must advance this single narrative with coherent, finished copy. **Mood, Keywords & Category:** rococo, romantic, pastel, gold, floral, ornate, cherubs, soft, luxury, dreamy, whimsical; era: 18th century; output category: **Luxury & Editorial** (generous whitespace, editorial typography, chapter-style section labels, refined ornamental detail). **Color Palette (Light Mode — the default):** - Background `#FDF6F0` (warm cream — never pure white; use `#FEFEFE` where a near-white surface is required) - Text `#6B4C40` (warm cocoa brown) - Gold accent `#EBC97A` - Pastels: Pale Pink `#FADADD`, Sky Blue `#C6E2FF`, Mint Green `#D0F0C0` **Signature Visual Effects (CSS-only unless noted):** - **Soft watercolor wash:** layered radial gradients — the hero must use the spec gradient `radial-gradient(circle, #FDF6F0 0%, #FADADD 100%)`; other sections receive subtle pastel washes at reduced opacity. - **Flowing golden ribbons:** gradient hairline dividers and curved pseudo-element flourishes. - **Ethereal glow:** soft gold/pink halo shadows behind display elements — never behind body text. - **Cherubs & blooming roses:** render via remote placeholder images (e.g., `https://picsum.photos/...`) with descriptive `alt` text and a replacement comment, or pure-CSS ornamental medallions (gradient rings, petal shapes via `border-radius`). **Inline SVG and local image files are forbidden.** - Ornate double-border frames, gentle floating ornament animations, and an optional editorial drop cap on the hero paragraph. **Typography & Icons (Google Fonts mandatory):** - `--font-display: 'Great Vibes', cursive` — per the source spec; the spec's global `font-family: 'Great Vibes'` is honored as the display face only: brand wordmark, hero headline, small ornamental accents. **Never for body copy, labels, buttons, or long text** (script fonts fail legibility at small sizes). - `--font-heading: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif` — section headings, card titles, prices, pull quotes. - `--font-base: 'Jost', sans-serif` — body copy, navigation, buttons (letter-spaced uppercase), forms. - Icons: **Google Material Symbols (Rounded)** exclusively (`material-symbols-rounded` class). Inline SVGs, local icon files, and emoji-as-icons are forbidden. **Copy Direction:** All user-facing copy in English, written in a romantic, whimsical, luxury-editorial voice — e.g., section eyebrows styled as chapters ("Chapter the First — The Art of Correspondence") and hero copy in the spirit of "An Atelier of Romantic Correspondence · Est. 1745" / "Where Love Is Written in Gold." Real, finished copy everywhere; lorem ipsum is forbidden. --- **PAGE BLUEPRINT — REQUIRED SECTIONS, IN THIS ORDER** **Sticky Header:** Brand wordmark (Great Vibes), anchor links (Features, How It Works, Testimonials, Pricing, FAQ), a gold `.btn--primary` "Reserve Your Letter" linking to the Final CTA, and the dark-mode toggle. Translucent cream `backdrop-blur` surface with a gold hairline bottom border. On mobile, links collapse behind a hamburger disclosure panel (ARIA-correct, Esc-to-close, layered with `--z-dropdown`). **1. Hero:** ~90vh; watercolor radial-gradient backdrop with ethereal glow; ornate frame; eyebrow label; Great Vibes headline with fluid `clamp()` sizing (~3rem–6rem); Cormorant subheadline; primary gold CTA + ghost secondary CTA; scroll cue; floating cherub/rose ornaments (subtle loop, reduced-motion-safe). **2. Features — 3 Cards:** Flexbox row → column on mobile; each card `flex: 1`. Gold-ringed Material Symbol medallion, Cormorant title, Jost body copy. Rotate pastel accents across the three cards: pink / sky blue / mint. Implement the full card state system (see 2.2). **3. How It Works — 3 Steps:** Semantic `
    `; Roman numerals I · II · III inside gold medallions; a golden-ribbon connector (horizontal on desktop, vertical on mobile); step title + copy for Compose → Embellish → Deliver. **4. Testimonials:** 3 quote cards; oversized gold quotation glyph; italic Cormorant pull quote; five-star rating using `star` icons (apply the `FILL` font-variation) with `aria-label="Rated 5 out of 5 stars"`; reviewer name and role; CSS initials medallion as avatar (no external avatar images). **5. Pricing — 3 Tiers:** "The Love Letter" / "The Grand Declaration" (featured) / "The Royal Commission". Featured card: gold border, glow, slight elevation, and a text badge "Most Beloved" (state must never rely on color alone). Feature lists with `check` icons; per-tier CTAs (featured = solid gold, others = outline). **6. FAQ — Accordion:** 5–6 items (delivery, customization, wax seals, letter privacy, returns). Button + panel pattern with `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls` and `role="region"`; `expand_more` icon rotating 180°; CSS-animated open/close (e.g., `grid-template-rows: 0fr → 1fr` — no JS height measuring); fully keyboard operable; Esc closes. **No modals or popups exist on this page — do not introduce any.** **7. Final CTA:** Full-width watercolor panel with ethereal glow and ornamental frame; Great Vibes headline; email-capture form implementing the complete input and button state systems (see 2.1 and 2.3): client-side validation, loading spinner, inline success/error messages inside an `aria-live="polite"` region. No `alert()`. **8. Footer:** Brand + short blurb + social presence as elegant text links (Material Symbols has no brand logos — do not fake them with SVG); three secondary-link columns (Atelier / Assistance / Legal); copyright bar. Secondary links may use `href="#"`. --- ## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE **1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS** - All styling lives in `style.css`. The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML. - Every design property, layout rule, and state is applied through class or ID selectors only. - HTML stays clean, semantic, and style-agnostic: re-theming the page must require editing CSS only, never markup. **1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens** Define all tokens in `:root` and override them in the dark theme: - **Colors:** `--primary: #EBC97A` (gold), `--secondary: #FADADD`, `--bg-primary: #FDF6F0`, `--bg-secondary: #FEFEFE`, `--text-primary: #6B4C40`, `--text-secondary` (muted brown, e.g., `#7D6157`), `--text-success: #3F7B53`, `--text-error: #B23A48`, `--border-default: #EAD9CD`, `--border-error`, `--border-success`. Theme extras: `--gold-deep: #D4AF6A`, `--pastel-pink: #FADADD`, `--pastel-blue: #C6E2FF`, `--pastel-mint: #D0F0C0`. - **Contrast pairing:** every light background token pairs with a dark text token and every dark background with a light text token — enforced in both themes. Gold `#EBC97A` must never be used as a text color on light backgrounds; in light mode gold is reserved for borders, ornaments, icon medallions, and button fills paired with `--text-primary` text. Gold text is permitted only on dark backgrounds. - Every text/background pair must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1 body, 3:1 large text); adjust token values if verification fails. - **Shape & depth:** `--radius-sm` (4px), `--radius-md` (12px), `--radius-lg` (24px), `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md` (warm-tinted, derived from `#6B4C40`). - **Motion & space:** `--spacing-gap` (1.5rem), `--transition-fast` (150ms), `--transition-normal` (300ms), `--ease-standard` (cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)). - **Layering:** `--z-dropdown` (100), `--z-modal` (1000), `--z-toast` (1100); the sticky header and mobile nav panel use the dropdown layer. **1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support** - **Exception:** Although the source style spec marked dark mode unsupported, it is mandatory here — implement a "Midnight Salon" palette that extends the Rococo mood: deep plum backgrounds (`--bg-primary: #2B2130`, `--bg-secondary: #372B3D`), cream text (`--text-primary: #F5EAE0`, `--text-secondary: #CBB9B0`), preserved gold `#EBC97A` (gold text permitted on dark), pastels used only as low-alpha washes and glows. - Provide dark tokens via `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` **and** a `.dark` class on ``; the class wins when applied. - **Persistence:** store the user's choice in `localStorage`, falling back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit. The header toggle shows `light_mode`/`dark_mode` Material Symbols with correct `aria-pressed` and `aria-label` state. - Theme switching must happen entirely through variable overrides — zero HTML restructuring. **1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment** - Build all layout structures with Flexbox. Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` unless an exception is explicitly justified in a CSS comment. - Mobile-first: feature, step, testimonial, pricing, and footer columns collapse to single columns on small viewports; nav links collapse behind the disclosure panel. No horizontal scrolling at any width from 320px up. Anchor navigation uses CSS smooth scrolling with `scroll-margin-top` offsets for the sticky header (disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`). **1.5 Framework Default & Tailwind CSS Integration** - Use Tailwind CSS (via CDN) or clean custom CSS organized with `@layer`/`@apply` conventions — the deliverable must run with zero build steps. All utility classes must map back to the CSS variables or to generic reusable component classes (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`); never hard-code hex values in utilities. **1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)** - Load Great Vibes, Cormorant Garamond (400–700 + italics), and Jost via Google Fonts `` tags; bind them to `--font-display`, `--font-heading`, `--font-base`. - Load the official Google Material Symbols (Rounded) stylesheet; every icon is a `icon_name`. - Inline SVGs, local icon files, and emoji-as-icons are forbidden. ## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS **2.1 Button Component Requirements** — all states as CSS classes: - **Default:** `.btn` uses `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;`, minimum touch target 44×44px, Jost label in letter-spaced uppercase.
